title: Israel quietly lifts block on night flights at Syria's airports
english: Syria's international airports in Damascus and Aleppo have resumed nighttime flights after Israel stopped blocking the necessary calibration tests for navigation equipment. Previously, Israel threatened to target any aircraft performing these tests due to concerns over its regional security and airspace control. The standoff was resolved when engineers found a way to conduct the required safety checks within a smaller radius, allowing the systems to finally become operational.

China is facing significant domestic economic challenges, making access to international markets critical for its growth. Additionally, while Xi expressed strong opposition to U.S. arms sales to Taiwan, the U.S. has yet to make a final commitment on scaling back that support.

title: Pope Leo heads to France amid assisted dying, abuse debates
english: Pope Leo XIV has begun his first official visit to France in nearly two decades, focusing on themes of human dignity. During his four-day trip, he will address sensitive topics, including France's new assisted dying law and the ongoing impact of historical clerical abuse. The Pope is expected to meet with survivors of abuse while also engaging with government officials and civil society on issues like migration and technology.

title: Nepal’s leader labels devastating flood a ‘warning to the world’
english: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah recently addressed the United Nations, describing the catastrophic glacial flooding that killed over 1,400 people in his country as an urgent warning about climate change. He criticized global leaders for failing to act quickly enough, noting that Nepal suffers severe consequences despite contributing almost nothing to global emissions. To address this, he proposed a regional cooperation mechanism to improve monitoring and early warning systems for the Himalayan region.

title: Israel’s Abu Farchi sent off for gun celebration in Nations League match
english: Israeli footballer Sayed Abu Farchi was sent off during a UEFA Nations League match against Austria after celebrating his goal by mimicking the use of a firearm with a corner flag. The referee issued a second yellow card for the provocative gesture, leaving Israel with ten men for the remainder of the game. Austria ultimately took advantage of the situation, winning the match 3-1.

oromo: Taphataan biyya Israa'el Sayed Abu Farchi tapha UEFA Nations League kan Ostriya waliin ta'e irratti goolii erga lakkoofsisee booda, alaabaa gubbaa dirree taphaa fayyadamee akka qawwee fakkeessee kabajachuu isaatiin kaardii diimaan dirree keessaa ari'ameera. title: Converging crises, chaos and walkouts dominate UNGA Day Three
english: The third day of the United Nations General Assembly was marked by significant turmoil and international disagreements. Many delegates staged a walkout during the speech delivered by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Meanwhile, other nations used the platform to highlight urgent issues, such as pleas for humanitarian aid in Yemen and concerns regarding the protection of national sovereignty in Kuwait.

title: Hurricane Polo lashes Mexico as Nolo strengthens near Hawaii
english: Two intense hurricanes are currently impacting different regions of the Pacific, with Hurricane Polo threatening the southwestern coast of Mexico and Hurricane Nolo approaching Hawaii. Authorities in Hawaii have declared a state of emergency and closed schools as they brace for significant flooding and heavy rain, particularly in areas already saturated from previous storms. Meanwhile, residents in Mexico's Michoacan region are dealing with severe damage as Polo continues to bring powerful winds and surging ocean waters to their communities.
amharic: ሁለት ኃይለኛ አውሎ ነፋሶች በአሁኑ ወቅት በፓሲፊክ ውቅያኖስ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ጉዳት እያደረሱ ሲሆን፣ አውሎ ነፋስ ፖሎ በሜክሲኮ ደቡብ ምዕራብ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን አውሎ ነፋስ ኖሎ ደግሞ ወደ ሃዋይ እየተቃረበ ይገኛል። የሃዋይ ባለስልጣናት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ ትምህርት ቤቶችን የዘጉ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ሲል በነበሩ አውሎ ነፋሶች ለጎርፍ በተጋለጡ አካባቢዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ዝናብ እና የመጥለቅለቅ አደጋ እንዳይከሰት ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ ነው። በሜክሲኮ ደግሞ አውሎ ነፋስ ፖሎ በባህር ዳርቻ በሚገኙ ከተሞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረስ የባህር ውሃ ወደ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እንዲገባ አድርጓል።

title: Meloni government bans burqas, caps foreign students in Italian schools
english: The Italian government, led by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, has introduced a decree banning face veils like burqas and niqabs in schools. Additionally, the new policy limits the number of non-Italian speaking students to 30 percent per classroom to encourage language integration. Failure to follow these rules will result in fines up to $1,140, though the decree still requires formal parliamentary approval.
amharic: የጣሊያን መንግስት በትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ የፊት መሸፈኛዎችን ማለትም ቡርቃ እና ነቃብን የሚከለክል አዲስ ህግ አውጥቷል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም በትምህርት ክፍሎች ውስጥ የጣሊያንኛ ቋንቋ የማይናገሩ ተማሪዎችን ቁጥር እስከ 30 በመቶ የሚገድብ ውሳኔ ተላልፏል። እነዚህን ህጎች የሚተላለፉ አካላት እስከ 1,140 ዶላር የሚደርስ ቅጣት የሚጠብቃቸው ሲሆን፣ ህጉ በስራ ላይ እንዲውል የፓርላማውን ይሁንታ ማግኘት ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Xaaliyaanii, muummicha ministeeraa Joorjiyaa Meloonii hoogganamu, mana barnoota keessatti haguuggii fuulaa kan akka burqaa fi niqaabaa dhowwuuf murteesseera.
